Introduction

cignature was a seven-member girl group under J9 Entertainment that debuted on February 4, 2020, with the digital single "Nun Nu Nan Na".

The group underwent lineup changes in 2021, with the departure of members Sunn and YeAh, and the addition of Chloe and Dohee. In 2023, member HyeonJu (formerly Belle) joined the survival show Universe Ticket and debuted as the leader of the project group UNIS.

Ultimately, on December 3, 2024, C9 Entertainment announced cignature's disbandment and the termination of all members' contracts.
